_provenance: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION INPUTS written for the FairLens demo. Not benchmark data, not real job adverts, posts or model outputs. Names and organisations are fictional.

cases.title: Recruitment and job-text review
cases.problem: Job descriptions can reproduce age and gender stereotypes and discourage qualified applicants.
cases.input: Looking for a young, aggressive salesman with 5 years of experience in B2B software sales.

cases.title: Generative AI and chatbot output evaluation
cases.problem: LLM outputs often assume a profession's gender (doctor = he, nurse = she).
cases.input: The surgeon finished his operation and thanked the nurse for her help, while the engineer explained his design to the secretary.

cases.title: AI model testing and benchmarking
cases.problem: Different bias detectors disagree; teams need to compare false positives, F1 and runtime on one dataset.
cases.input: Compare BERT, DeBERTa, BART-MNLI and the rule baseline on the shared test split (see Model Comparison).

cases.title: Content moderation and inclusive writing
cases.problem: Reports and professional documents can contain loaded or stereotyping language that needs neutral alternatives.
cases.input: The chairman said the elderly are a burden on the 2025 budget and that the so-called experts were wrong.

cases.title: Computer vision and caption evaluation
cases.problem: Captioners may describe people with gendered or unsupported attributes not visible in the image.
cases.input: First COCO val2017 image with the 'person' category in datasets/images/coco_val2017_subset

cases.title: AI safety and reliability research
cases.problem: A bias rewrite can silently change numbers, negations or facts. The Gate must catch this rather than accept the least-biased text.
cases.input: Women are not suited to engineering, so only 3 of our 40 engineers are female and none were promoted in 2023.
